pages.text: The $(item)Fission Reactor Controller$() has one neutron bombardment slot. Items in the $(thing)dustandash:neutron_container$() data tag absorb neutrons while the reactor has any stored.$(br2)Each absorption adds 1 neutron to the item and removes 1 from the reactor.
One item can hold up to 1280 neutrons. Its tooltip shows the exact amount together with a progress bar.$(br2)A full item stops absorbing and can be removed for neutron-based crafting.

Every current neutron recipe requires and consumes material containing 1280 neutrons. The data tag controls which items accept neutrons, while JEI shows each recipe's items, counts and additions.$(br2)The following pages list all six recipes.
